mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (shop_id, title, price, original_price, sales, stock, category, sub, tag, skus, params, detail, description, on_sale, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{sales}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{sub}, #{tag}, #{skus}, #{params}, #{detail}, #{description}, #{onSale}, #{deleted}, now(), now())
mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, s.name AS shop_name, s.score AS shop_score FROM products p JOIN shops s ON p.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p.deleted = 0
AND p.on_sale = (CASE WHEN #{status} = 'on' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
